place.zh: 石坳村 · 屋后柴垛 · 夜

_weather: 「疼停下来的时候，月亮已经从柴垛这头挪到了那头」: a moonlit night (Hanli 2026-10-14: 「可以，月夜标成晴」)

setup.zh: 银月钻进木牌的那天夜里，你把洗髓丹扔进娘洗衣裳的大木盆，一盆清水变成了墨绿。今夜就泡。疼，别喊。
setup.en: The night Yinyue went into the token, you drop the Marrow-Washing Pill into your mother's big washtub, and the clear water turns dark green. Soak tonight. It hurts; don't cry out.

recap.zh: 你泡了洗髓丹，一声没吭；一蹦，脑袋撞上了一丈高的顶梁。第二天，娘把那只木盆刷了三遍，什么也没问。
recap.en: You soaked in the Marrow-Washing Pill without a sound; one jump, and your head hit a beam ten feet up. Next morning your mother scrubbed the tub three times and asked nothing.

zh: 一只大木盆，一盆墨绿的水。
一蹦，撞上了一丈高的顶梁。
en: A big washtub of dark green water.
One jump — and a beam ten feet up.

story.zh:
银月化光钻进木牌的那天夜里，小满泡了她留下的洗髓丹。他从井里拎了七桶水，倒进他娘洗衣裳的大木盆。那颗药丸扔进去，「滋」的一声化开了，一盆清水登时变成了墨绿色，咕嘟咕嘟冒着泡。

他脱了衣裳，把那块木牌挂在柴垛的一根枝杈上，冲它道：「你看着。我不喊。」说完便一咬牙，泡了进去。
story.en:
The night Yinyue turned to light and went into the tablet, Xiaoman soaked in the Marrow-Washing Pill she'd left. He hauled seven buckets of water up from the well and poured them into the big wooden tub his mother did the washing in. He dropped the pill in, it dissolved with a *tsss*, and the clear water at once turned dark green and started bubbling.

He took off his clothes, hung the wooden tablet on a forked stick in the woodpile, and said to it, "You watch. I won't yell." Then he set his teeth and got in.

label.en: Get in, and not a sound

exits.means: soaks in the marrow-washing bath, endures it silently

story.zh:
那是从骨头缝里往外钻的疼。他咬住了自己的胳膊，咬出了血，一声没吭。一盆水从墨绿变成了漆黑。

他扶着盆沿爬出来，皮肤底下淡淡的有一层光。他试着往上蹦了一下，「咚」的一声，脑袋已撞上了柴棚的顶梁。「你爷爷的——」他从枝杈上取下那块木牌，道：「银月。我没喊。」木牌没有回答。

第二天一早，他跑到井台边，只见他娘蹲在那里，一下一下地刷那只盆。她起身进屋去了，走到门口，没回头，道：「那盆，往后晚上要用，自己拿。用完了，自己刷。」

这是他娘这辈子，头一回替他藏了一样东西。
story.en:
It was a pain that drilled outward from the cracks between his bones. He bit down on his own arm, bit till it bled, and didn't make a sound. The tub of water went from dark green to pitch black.

He hauled himself out by the edge of the tub. There was a faint layer of light under his skin. He tried a little jump — *thunk* — and his head had already hit the ridge beam of the woodshed. "Your grandpa's—" He took the tablet down from the forked stick and said, "Yinyue. I didn't yell." The tablet didn't answer.

Early next morning he ran to the well platform and found his mother crouched there scrubbing the tub, stroke after stroke. She got up and went indoors. At the door, without turning round, she said, "That tub. If you want it at night from now on, fetch it yourself. When you're done, scrub it yourself."

It was the first time in her life his mother had hidden something for him.

story_full.zh:
那是从骨头缝里往外钻的疼，从脚趾头一寸一寸钻到头发梢。他咬住了自己的胳膊，咬出了血，一声没吭。他身上不住地往外渗东西，黑的，黏的，一盆水从墨绿变成了漆黑。他疼得眼前一阵一阵地发白，白里头，有时候是他娘蹲在地上捡碗的样子，有时候是他爹吊在崖上伸下来的那只手。

疼停下来的时候，月亮已经从柴垛这头挪到了那头。他扶着盆沿爬出来，皮肤底下淡淡的有一层光，像月亮底下的一块玉。那只肿了几天的手腕，一点也不肿了。他试着往上蹦了一下，「咚」的一声，脑袋已撞上了柴棚的顶梁。「你爷爷的——」那根梁，离地少说也有一丈。他捂着脑袋蹲在地上，把脸埋在膝盖里笑。笑够了，他从枝杈上取下那块木牌，攥在手心里，道：「银月。我没喊。」木牌没有回答。

第二天一早，那只大木盆不见了。他跑到井台边，只见他娘蹲在那里，拿一把稻草蘸着草木灰，一下一下地刷那只盆。盆里的黑水倒在井台底下的阴沟里，阴沟里的草一夜之间全黄了。她刷完了第三遍，把木盆扣在井台上晾着，这才抬起头来，看他那只左手。小满把手往身后藏了藏，又拿出来晃了晃，龇牙咧嘴地道：「娘，还疼着呢。」他娘看了一会儿，道：「那就再缠两天。」

她起身进屋去了，走到门口，没回头，道：「那盆，往后晚上要用，自己拿。用完了，自己刷。」

这是他娘这辈子，头一回替他藏了一样东西。
story_full.en:
It was a pain that drilled outward from the cracks between his bones, drilled inch by inch from his toes to the ends of his hair. He bit down on his own arm, bit till it bled, and didn't make a sound. Things kept seeping out of his body, black and sticky, and the tub of water went from dark green to pitch black. The pain made everything go white in front of his eyes, again and again, and in the white, sometimes there was his mother crouched on the floor picking up the bowl, and sometimes there was the hand his father had reached down from the cliff.

When the pain stopped, the moon had moved from this end of the woodpile to the other. He hauled himself out by the edge of the tub. There was a faint layer of light under his skin, like a piece of jade under the moon. The wrist that had been swollen for days wasn't swollen at all. He tried a little jump — *thunk* — and his head had already hit the ridge beam of the woodshed. "Your grandpa's—" That beam was a good ten feet off the ground. He crouched holding his head, buried his face in his knees, and laughed. When he'd laughed enough, he took the tablet down from the forked stick, clutched it in his palm, and said, "Yinyue. I didn't yell." The tablet didn't answer.

Early next morning the big wooden tub had gone. He ran to the well platform and found his mother crouched there scrubbing the tub with a handful of straw dipped in wood ash, stroke after stroke. The black water from the tub had been poured into the drain below the well platform, and overnight all the grass in the drain had turned yellow. She finished the third scrub, set the tub upside down on the well platform to dry, and only then looked up at his left hand. Xiaoman hid the hand behind his back, then brought it out and waved it, grimacing: "Ma, it still hurts." His mother looked at it a while. "Then keep it wrapped two more days."

She got up and went indoors. At the door, without turning round, she said, "That tub. If you want it at night from now on, fetch it yourself. When you're done, scrub it yourself."

It was the first time in her life his mother had hidden something for him.

label.en: It hurts too much — climb out

exits.means: gives up the bath, climbs out

story.zh:
小满一只手扒上了盆沿。

挂在枝杈上的木牌凉凉的，那一条银色的尾巴，一明，一暗。她说：疼，别喊。她没说可以出来。

他的手，一点一点地松开了。他沉回那一盆墨绿的菜汤里。
story.en:
Xiaoman got one hand over the rim of the tub.

The token hanging on the fork was cool; its one silver tail went bright, dim. She'd said: it hurts, don't cry out. She hadn't said he could get out.

His hand let go, bit by bit. He sank back into the tub of dark-green soup.
